name: Al Capone (illustrated representation, 1930-31)
depiction: Illustrated representation, not a likeness. A generic heavy-set 1920s-30s man in a dark overcoat, white shirt, dark tie and a plain grey fedora: no scar, no photo reference, no famous image recreated. Never shown with a weapon, alcohol, cash, in any violent act or near any victim; never posed heroically; none of his words are quoted. Every shot he is in is tagged 'ILLUSTRATION · NOT A LIKENESS'.
